description: Turn fashion inspiration into products you can actually buy. Snap or upload a photo of any outfit — or just type what you're after ('blue denim jacket', 'leather handbag') — and Outfit Lens finds real products from online retailers: similar items that match what you saw, plus Style With picks (tops, shoes, bags, accessories) that complete the look. Compare prices at a glance and jump straight to the retailer to buy. Perfect for shopping a street style you spotted, a screenshot you saved, or a look you can't stop thinking about.
